#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> convolve(const vector<int>& x, const vector<int>& y, int mod) {
    int len = x.size() + y.size() - 1;
    int size = 1;
    while (size < len) size <<= 1;
    
    vector<double> xr(size, 0.0), xi(size, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < x.size(); i++) {
        long long v = ((long long)x[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        xr[i] = v & 0x7FFF;
        xi[i] = v >> 15;
    }
    
    // FFT
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int bit = size >> 1;
        while (j & bit) {
            j ^= bit;
            bit >>= 1;
        }
        j ^= bit;
        if (i < j) {
            swap(xr[i], xr[j]);
            swap(xi[i], xi[j]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int step = 2; step <= size; step <<= 1) {
        int half = step >> 1;
        vector<double> c(half), s(half);
        double ang = 2 * M_PI / step * (step == size ? -1 : 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
            c[i] = cos(i * ang);
            s[i] = sin(i * ang);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i += step) {
            for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
                double ur = xr[i + k];
                double ui = xi[i + k];
                double vr = xr[i + k + half] * c[k] - xi[i + k + half] * s[k];
                double vi = xr[i + k + half] * s[k] + xi[i + k + half] * c[k];
                
                xr[i + k] = ur + vr;
                xi[i + k] = ui + vi;
                xr[i + k + half] = ur - vr;
                xi[i + k + half] = ui - vi;
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<double> yr(size, 0.0), yi(size, 0.0);
    if (x == y) {
        copy(xr.begin(), xr.end(), yr.begin());
        copy(xi.begin(), xi.end(), yi.begin());
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < y.size(); i++) {
            long long v = ((long long)y[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            yr[i] = v & 0x7FFF;
            yi[i] = v >> 15;
        }
        
        // FFT for y
        for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int bit = size >> 1;
            while (j & bit) {
                j ^= bit;
                bit >>= 1;
            }
            j ^= bit;
            if (i < j) {
                swap(yr[i], yr[j]);
                swap(yi[i], yi[j]);
            }
        }
        
        for (int step = 2; step <= size; step <<= 1) {
            int half = step >> 1;
            vector<double> c(half), s(half);
            double ang = 2 * M_PI / step * (step == size ? -1 : 1);
            for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
                c[i] = cos(i * ang);
                s[i] = sin(i * ang);
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i += step) {
                for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
                    double ur = yr[i + k];
                    double ui = yi[i + k];
                    double vr = yr[i + k + half] * c[k] - yi[i + k + half] * s[k];
                    double vi = yr[i + k + half] * s[k] + yi[i + k + half] * c[k];
                    
                    yr[i + k] = ur + vr;
                    yi[i + k] = ui + vi;
                    yr[i + k + half] = ur - vr;
                    yi[i + k + half] = ui - vi;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<double> resR(size, 0.0), resI(size, 0.0);
    double factor = 0.25 / size;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);
        
        double A1r = xr[i] + xr[j];
        double A1i = xi[i] - xi[j];
        double A2r = xi[i] + xi[j];
        double A2i = xr[j] - xr[i];
        
        double B1r = (yr[i] + yr[j]) * factor;
        double B1i = (yi[i] - yi[j]) * factor;
        double B2r = (yi[i] + yi[j]) * factor;
        double B2i = (yr[j] - yr[i]) * factor;
        
        resR[i] = A1r * B1r - A1i * B1i - A2r * B2i - A2i * B2r;
        resI[i] = A1r * B1i + A1i * B1r + A2r * B2r - A2i * B2i;
    }
    
    // Inverse FFT
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int bit = size >> 1;
        while (j & bit) {
            j ^= bit;
            bit >>= 1;
        }
        j ^= bit;
        if (i < j) {
            swap(resR[i], resR[j]);
            swap(resI[i], resI[j]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int step = 2; step <= size; step <<= 1) {
        int half = step >> 1;
        vector<double> c(half), s(half);
        double ang = 2 * M_PI / step;
        for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
            c[i] = cos(i * ang);
            s[i] = sin(i * ang);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i += step) {
            for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
                double ur = resR[i + k];
                double ui = resI[i + k];
                double vr = resR[i + k + half] * c[k] - resI[i + k + half] * s[k];
                double vi = resR[i + k + half] * s[k] + resI[i + k + half] * c[k];
                
                resR[i + k] = ur + vr;
                resI[i + k] = ui + vi;
                resR[i + k + half] = ur - vr;
                resI[i + k + half] = ui - vi;
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        resR[i] /= size;
        resI[i] /= size;
    }
    
    vector<int> out(len);
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        long long a = llround(resR[i]);
        long long b = llround(resI[i]);
        out[i] = (int)((a + ((b % mod) << 15)) % mod);
    }
    return out;
}

int main() {
    int N, K;
    cin >> N >> K;
    
    vector<int> base(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        int val;
        cin >> val;
        base[val] = 1;
    }
    
    vector<int> result = {1};
    int exp = N / 2;
    
    while (true) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            result = convolve(result, base, MOD);
        }
        exp >>= 1;
        if (exp == 0) break;
        base = convolve(base, base, MOD);
    }
    
    long long sum = 0;
    for (int val : result) {
        sum = (sum + (long long)val * val) % MOD;
    }
    cout << sum << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
